integrity: The claim follows from a direct specialization of the published iteration and a complete coordinatewise proof; finite computations are used only as sanity checks, and residual literature risk is stated explicitly.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to \(S=\prod_i[-R_i,R_i]\), \(A=I_n\), \(h\equiv0\), \(g(u)=\|u\|_1\), and initialization \(z^0=0\).
The exact identity concerns accumulated \(\ell_1\) motion; Euclidean primal length is bounded above by \(\|x^0\|_1\) but is not claimed to equal it.
No extension to coupled linear maps, arbitrary feasible sets, or arbitrary nonsmooth objectives is asserted.
title: Exact coordinatewise finite-length law for ℓ1 S-FSPS
